chapter: Army band and the Waifs' Home
title: How he got into the Army brass band by playing bugle
summary: Punch walked out of line to play a bugle call, was placed in the brass band and studied there; he knew only blues when he went in.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
